title: MPESB ASI / HC PPT Result 2026 – Out
postName: ASI (Computer) / Head Constable Computer – PPT Status 2026
vacancyDetails: ASI/HC Computer cadre PPT (Physical Proficiency Test) status for posts under MPESB police computer recruitment
qualification: As per MPESB ASI Computer / HC Computer recruitment rules
selectionProcess: Written Exam → PPT / Physical → Final stages as per board
documentsRequired: Application number, DOB for result login; physical test related documents if called further
howToApply:
1. Visit https://esb.mp.gov.in
2. Open Results section
3. Find ASI / HC Computer PPT Result 2026 PDF or login link

shortDescription: MPESB has released ASI / HC Computer PPT Result 2026. Written exam was on 24 March 2026; PPT status list available on esb.mp.gov.in.
content:
MPESB has published the Physical Proficiency Test (PPT) status for Assistant Sub-Inspector (Computer) / Head Constable (Computer) Recruitment Test 2026.

Written examination was held on 24 March 2026; written result was declared earlier (8 May 2026). PPT status PDF shows overall PASS/FAIL against application numbers.

Candidates should download the official PPT status PDF from esb.mp.gov.in and prepare for further stages if declared pass.
